<sense>

<entry id="M01644">
<head-word>מ"ם</head-word>

<sup>b</sup> מ"ם דשם סתומה Ms. O. (ed. סתום) the Mem in 
<italic>shem</italic> is closed (final letter); מ"ם שמעון פתוחה (ed. פתוח) the Mem in Shimʿon is open (initial letter). Ib. 104

<italic>Mems</italic> intimate that there are subjects in the Law which are open to all, and such as are closed (esoteric studies). Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>d</sup> מהו דין דכתיב מ"ם מ"ם וכ' why is it that the letters 
<italic>Mem, Nun</italic> &c. are written in two ways?—Maas. Sh. IV, 11; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מֵמִין, מֵימִין</plural-form>. Sabb. 103
<sup>a</sup> one must not write מ' סמכין וכ' 
<italic>Mem</italic> like 
<italic>Samekh</italic> or vice versa; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>; B. Bath. 137
<sup>b</sup> (Ms. R. דאַתּוּן); 151
<sup>a</sup> (ed. Pes. מַמּוּלְיָאתָה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M01651">
<head-word>מָמוֹן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (contr. of מהמון, v. 
<xref rid="E00597">הָמוֹן</xref>; הָמָה) 
<italic>accumulation, wealth, value</italic> (in Greek writers: 
<italic>Mammon</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Matt. 7 אתם חיבבתם את מָמוֹנְכֶם וכ' you loved your wealth (of cattle) more than your souls; Num. R. s. 12. Ib.; Tanḥ. l. c. 6 מ̇מ̇ון̇ מ̇ה שאתה מ̇ונ̇ה אינו כלום money is named 
<italic>mamon</italic>, that which thou countest is nothing. B. Mets. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. מ' המוטל בספק property of doubtful ownership (with several claimants). Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 13; B. Kam. 116
<sup>b</sup> מחשבין לפי מ' the loss of a caravan attacked by robbers (the redemption paid them) is apportioned according to the value of the freight which each passenger carried, contrad. to לפי נפשות according to the number of passengers. Ib. 83
<sup>b</sup> עין תחת עין מ' ‘eye for eye’ (Ex. XXI, 24) means a fine in value, opp. עין ממש an actual putting out of the eye; a. v. fr.—[Pesik. R. s. 21 (ed. Fr., p. 105
<sup>b</sup>) אין אתה עומד במימיו, read במָמוֹנוֹ, thou canst not define its value; Fr. a. l. emends בטִימְיוֹ, v. טִימֵי.]—
<plural-form>Pl. מָמוֹנוֹת</plural-form>. Snh. I, 1, v. דִּין; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>sagan</italic> (Tosef. ib. IV, </notes></sense>

<number>1)</number>

<italic>m’munneh</italic> (in Mish. l. c.), i.e. the deputy high priest.</definition>

<plural-form>Pl. מְמוּנִּים, מְמוּנִּין</plural-form>. Ib. 1 אלו הן המ' וכ' those were the special officers in the Temple; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Maneh</italic> was double the weight of the common. Ib. VIII, 7 במ' צורי taking the Tyrian 
<italic>M</italic>. as a standard. Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup> מ' צורי … מ' של צורי ‘the Tyrian M.’ … means the standard of the Tyrian system (one Sela = 4 Zuz, Rashi). Keth. I, 2 בתולה … מאתים ואלמנה מ' the widowhood of a maiden is two hundred (Zuz), and that of a widow (remarried) is one hundred (Zuz, a common Shekel). B. Kam. 90
<sup>b</sup> מ' צורי תנן או מ' מדינה תנן does the Mishnah (VIII, 6) mean a Tyrian or a country Maneh (twelve and a half Zuz)? Shebu. VI, 1 מ' לי בידך thou owest me one hundred denars. Snh. VIII, 2 מ' בשר meat of the weight of a Maneh. Shebi. I, 2 ששים מ' באיטלקי the weight of sixty M. in the Italian system. Ker. 6
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Erub. 85
<sup>a</sup> bot. פנו מקום לבן מאה מ' make room for one worth one hundred M. (in gold).—Trnsf. מ' בן פרס a Maneh son of a P’ras (half a Maneh), i.e. 
<italic>a distinguished son of a less distinguished father</italic>. Taan. 21
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. מָנִים, מָנִין</plural-form>. Y. Shek. VI, 49
<sup>c</sup> bot. אלף … מ' the weight of fifteen hundred M. Ker. l. c.; a. e.—Chald. form: מָנֵי. Targ. Ez. XLV, 12 (Kimḥi מָנָא).—
<plural-form>Pl. מָנִין, מָנַיָּא, מָנָן, מָנָאֵי, מָנוֹי</plural-form>. Ib. Targ. Is. VII, 23. Targ. I Kings X, 17; a. e.—Esth. R. to VI, 10; Lev. R. s. 28.—Sabb. 133
<sup>b</sup> שב מ' תרבא (not מינאי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) fat weighing seven M. (Rashi: seven 
<italic>portions</italic> of fat). Y. B. Kam. IX, 6
<sup>d</sup> bot. [read as Tosaf. to Bab. ib. 100
<sup>b</sup>:) חמש מנוי עמר וח' מ' סממנין וכ' wool worth five M., dyeing material worth five, and ten M. wages. Y. Meg. IV, 74
<sup>d</sup> bot. מניי (corr. acc.); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מונין ללבנה regulate the seasons by the moon (have a lunar year). Men. 65
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. מְנֵה ימים וכ' count the required number of days and proclaim (one day as) the New Moon Day. Yoma V, 3; a. fr.—Part. pass. מָנוּי; f. מְנוּיָה; pl. מְנוּיִים, מְנוּיִין, מְנוּיִן; מְנוּיוֹת a) 
<italic>counted</italic>. Taan. 8
<sup>b</sup> דבר המ' that which has been counted (is known by number). Bekh. IX, 7 אחד מן המ' one of the sheep already counted.—b) 
<italic>classified</italic>; (
<italic>pl.</italic>) 
<italic>class</italic>. Ḥag. 17
<sup>b</sup> מה חדש למְנוּיָיו אף עצרת למְנוּיָיו (עצרת = שבוע של ע') as the New Moon festival belongs to its class (of days), so does the Pentecost (which is determined by counting weeks) belong to its class (of weeks), i.e. the pilgrim’s sacrifice (חגיגה) may be offered during the entire eighth week from Passover; R. Hash. 5
<sup>a</sup> למְנוּיָו.—c) (v. 
<italic>Nif.</italic>)

<sup>a</sup> bot. איתקש אוכלין למנויין (Ms. M. אוכליו למנוייו) the partakers (to be held in mind) are analogous to the registered. Ib. 70
<sup>a</sup> אינה … למְנוּיֶהָ Ms. M. (ed. incorr. למנוייו, למנויו) it (the pilgrim’s sacrifice) can only be partaken of by those registered for it; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-form>נִמְנֶה, נִי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be counted</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 1 אינן נִמְנִים ולא נמדדין are neither numbered nor measured. Bets. 3
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. את שדרכו לִימָּנוֹת, v. אֵת. Gitt. V, 6 נִמְנוּ (usu. נמנו וגמרו) they (their votes) were counted, they resolved, v. גָּמַר II; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be counted on for a share in the Passover lamb, to be registered</italic> (Ex. XII, 4).</definition>
<notes> Pes. VIII, 3 לעולם נִימְנִין עליו וכ' persons may continually be entered for a share in it, as long as there remains for each &c. Ib. נימנין ומושכין וכ' they may be entered and withdraw again. Ib. 89
<sup>a</sup> אבל לִימָּנוֹת but as for registering (additional names). Tosef. ib. VII, 7 רצו להמשך ולהִמָּנוֹת וכ' (ed. Zuck. incorr.) if some of them wish to withdraw and have others entered on their share &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be specified</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Mish. IV, 5) מה ראה … להִימָּנוֹת what reason was there for that specification of the time when each family of priests and the people had to offer wood?; Y. Shek. IV, beg. 47
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Meg. I, 70
<sup>c</sup> top.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִמְנָה, הִי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to be entered; to add to the number of sharers; to transmit one’s share to another person</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. VIII, 36
<sup>a</sup> top הי' אותו על חנם he gave him a share gratuitously. Tosef. ib. l. c. בני חבורה שרצו להַמְנוֹת וכ' (ed. Zuck. לַמְנוֹת) members of a party who desire to give others a share in their own portion. Ib. המַמְנֶה אחרים על חלקו (ed. Zuck. פסחו) he who assigns to others a share in his portion; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּמְנֶה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be added to the number; to be entered as a member of a group or of a family</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. ib. 3 ה' על אחד מהם if he (the orphan) has been entered as his guest by one of the guardians. Ib. 6 בני חבורה שהוּמְנוּ וכ' ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. שנמנו) members of a group who have been entered (in a body) in addition to the original participants; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מִנָּה, מִי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to appoint, elect.</italic></definition>
<notes> Gitt. V, 4 שמי' להן אביהן וכ' for whom their father had appointed an executor. Ib. שמִינָּהוּ אבי וכ' whom the father … has appointed. Taan. 10
<sup>b</sup> כל שראוי למַנּוֹתוֹ וכ' who is worthy to be elected manager &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְמוּנֶּה; 
<plural-form>pl. מְמוּנִּים</plural-form>. Sot. 42
<sup>a</sup> למה סגן ממ' for what purpose is a deputy high priest appointed?; Yoma 39
<sup>a</sup> מימינו ed. (corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); a. fr.—Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> שאביהם ממונים פרנס וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שממ' אביהם, = מן הממונים) whose father is of those worthy to be elected manager (v. Taan. l. c.).—V. מְמוּנֶּה.—Esp. 
<italic>to ordain as teacher and judge</italic>. Y. Snh. I, 19
<sup>a</sup> bot. ב"ד שמי' שלא וכ' a court that ordained without the consent of the Nasi. Ib. היה כל אחד מְמַנֶּה וכ' each teacher used to ordain his own pupils; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְמַנֶּה, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be appointed, designated as deputy, to be ordained</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra Aḥăré Par. 5, ch. VIII לרבות כהן אחר המִתְמַנֶּה to imply the other priest that is designated as a deputy. Y. Bicc. III, 65
<sup>d</sup> top חכם שנ' וכ' when a scholar is ordained, his sins are forgiven. Ib. זה שהוא מתמ' בכסף וכ' (not מתמני) before him who has been ordained for money, we must not stand up, nor do we call him rabbi, and the cloak upon him is like the cover of ass. Yoma 22
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> bot. מאי אם זה שנ' על … אתם שאתם מִתְמַנִּין וכ' if this one appointed superintendent of wicks, was privileged to be counted among the great of the generation, how much more you who are to be appointed over the preservation of lives (as directors of charities). R. Hash. II, 9 (25
<sup>a</sup>) שנִתְמַנּוּ ב"ד על וכ' Ms. O. (ed. שעמדו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) who have been ordained as a court for all Israel; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of things) 
<italic>to be assigned</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sot. VII, 20 נִתְמַנָּה לאדם פרנסה וכ' if a livelihood has been assigned to a man (by Providence, i.e. if he has succeeded in establishing a livelihood), he must buy a house; חזר נ' לו יקח וכ' (v. ed. <sense>
<number>1)</number>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be appointed; to be ordained</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CX, 4; 6; a. fr.—Y. Bicc. l. c. חד מן אילין דמיתמני בכסף (read: דמִיתְמַנִּין) one of those ordained for money’s sake. Ib. (adapting Hab. II, 19) לא בכספייא אי' וכ' has he not been ordained for money? &c. Ib. לא קבל עלוי מִתְמַנֵּי he would not allow himself to be ordained; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be designated for a share</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Ex. XII, 4.—Pes. 89
<sup>a</sup> ונִימְּנִינְהוּ בהדי כל חד וחד Ms. M. (Ms. O. ונִימְּנֵי כל חד וחד בהדיה; ed. ונימני עילויה הני וכ', read עילוי דהני; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) and let them be designated as participants with each of them (and let each of them be designated &c.). Ib. בתר דשחיט מי קא מתמני after the lamb is slaughtered how can he be entered? Ib. 60
<sup>b</sup> ומִימְּנוּ עילויה אחריני (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) and other persons will be entered for a share in it; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
